player_prompt.intro:
Sida Player {player_id} ri Nim.
Tujuanna sida makkaluwari benda sisa-sisa.
Ri kada sari, pili' pile sadja sibawa bongka benda sadja ataupun lebbi.
Gunaka format '[pile quantity]', iya pile indeks pile sibawa quantity jumla benda ri bongka.
Contona, '[0 3]' bongka 3 benda ri pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Degaga format appelle iya valid. Pakkegunai '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Pemain {player_id}, Aksi tena'. Kolom {col} lalua' ri wates.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Tidak bisa bongka {quantity} ri pile {pile_index} (sadja {pile_count} tasisa).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} main [{pile_index} {quantity}], bongka {quantity} benda ri pile {pile_index}.
